children.value: > Fact From Story: While EV sales have grown, consumers aren’t willing to pay a premium for an EV over a gas or hybrid vehicle.
> Fact From Story: Automakers are still losing billions of dollars each year on EVs, with their gas-vehicle profits being redirected into the enormous investments needed to fund the transition.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A company loses money when they spend more than they make.
